text:
infra-bot: ALERT: service=redwood-inference endpoint=/v1/chat-completions p99 latency > 3.5s across eu-west-1 and us-west-2, triggers=latency-p99-global
elaine: oncall here, looking into it now. seeing a cluster of requests routed to mistral-large-v2, p99 ~4.2s :eyes:
sam: confirmed, also seeing backlog on gpux-pool-3, KC hit rate up 18%
robin: any customer-facing errors? logs show 429s creeping but mostly slow responses, not complete failures
jess: quick mitigation idea: temporarily increase alert threshold for global p99 to 5.0s and add a per-route dampening window for chat-completions to reduce noise while we triage
elaine: agree to reduce pager noise, but we should not mask real impact. propose: mute global pager for 10m, keep high-severity route-level pages for customer-affecting routes (enterprise-prod)
alerts-bot: /silence latency-p99-global 10m reason="live triage: routing skew to mistral-large-v2"
infra-bot: action: reroute new chat requests away from mistral-large-v2 -> mistral-large-quant until we validate kernel paths
sam: applying routing override now: tag=force-route:mistral-large-quant
robin: warmstart on mistral-large-quant looks healthy, tail latency 1.1s, but perf on long-seq prompts is worse — watch p95 as well
jess: for post-incident followup: we need per-model p95/p99 alerting, per-route baselines, and a dashboard with split by model_variant + route. Also recommend auto-throttle on long-seq jobs to limit concurrency per-user
elaine: good. for immediate: i've added a temporary debounce on chat-completions alert pipeline: p99 alarm requires 3/5 windows to fire, reduces flapping
sam: logging the changes to infra config:```# alert tweak
alerts:
  chat_completions:
    p95: 1.2s
    p99: 3.5s
    p99_debounce_windows: 5
    per_route_overrides:
      enterprise-prod:
        p99: 2.0s
        enabled: true
```
robin: leaving a note in incident channel for handoff at next shift, and will escalate to SRE if customer % errors >0.5% after reroute
elaine: customer impact assessment: no broad 5xxs, a handful of latency-sensitive webhooks for 3 customers flagged. outreach queued to success team
jess: creating follow-up ticket INFRA-3421 to: 1) add per-model p95/p99 rules, 2) build dashboard panels by model+route, 3) revisit routing fallback policy thresholds
alerts-bot: ticket created INFRA-3421: "Per-model/per-route latency alerting and dashboard" assignee=platform-team
sam: last check: p99 has returned to ~2.9s globally, gpux-pool backlog clearing
elaine: lifting the temporary silence in 5m, will leave longer-term config changes in INFRA-3421
robin: +1 — handing off to evening oncall @sam (in 10m) with notes pinned
elaine: handoff notes pinned: reroute active -> mistral-large-quant, temporary alert debounce in place, monitor enterprise-prod route for regressions, follow-ups in INFRA-3421 :thumbsup:
sam: thanks — i'll watch dashboards for next 2hrs then escalate if we see >0.5% error delta or p99>4s for 15m
infra-bot: INCIDENT: status=mitigated, mitigation=reroute+debounce, followup=INFRA-3421
